name: Flann

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Flann is an Irish hero, and the name means blood-red. Several minor mythic figures carry the name. Two of them stand out, and both are famed lovers. They may be two forms of one man. Flann mac Dima loved Mugain, the wife of Diarmait mac Cerbaill. Diarmait burned down Flann's house and made him drown. That deed drew a curse onto Diarmait. Flann ua Fedach is the other figure. This Fairy King ran off with Becfhola, the queen of Tara.

okr.objective: Flann is the name of several famed Irish lovers in the old tales.
